description: This file defines a DialogFragment class that displays a dialog with an input field for creating a new playlist. It interacts with repositories to retrieve the current user ID and create the playlist asynchronously using coroutines.

classes.name: CreatePlaylistDialog
classes.description: A DialogFragment that prompts the user to enter a new playlist name and creates the playlist upon confirmation.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns an AlertDialog with an input field for playlist name, and handles user actions to create the playlist using repositories.
